summary:
ARES PATH — Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map is an interactive platform developed to make Mars exploration data easier to explore, understand and connect. Focused primarily on Jezero Crater, it brings together six modules: an interactive 3D Mars Explorer, a scientific mapping system, a conceptual Marswalk Planner, location-based Survival Intelligence and structured Mission Reports.

Using NASA Mars mapping and scientific datasets, users can explore Martian terrain, examine surface imagery, create conceptual surface routes using waypoints, and access environmental and scientific information from different Mars missions. The platform also generates downloadable mission reports in PDF and JSON formats.

ARES PATH addresses the challenge by connecting scattered Mars exploration information through one accessible, interactive system. It is important because it helps students, researchers and space enthusiasts better understand the Martian environment and the scientific information needed to study and plan future exploration.
details: ARES PATH is an interactive Mars exploration platform focused primarily on Jezero Crater. It combines six modules: a 3D Mars Explorer, Scientific Map, Marswalk Planner, Survival Intelligence, Mission Reports and an Overview dashboard. Users can explore Mars, examine NASA scientific imagery, create conceptual surface routes using waypoints, access location-based environmental information and generate PDF and JSON mission reports. The project makes scattered Mars exploration data easier to access, understand and connect. Its innovative approach brings planetary visualization, scientific mapping, route planning and evidence-based information together in one platform. We developed it using React, TypeScript, Vite, Three.js, React Three Fiber, OpenLayers and jsPDF, integrating NASA Mars Trek services and relevant CTX, HiRISE, MOLA and THEMIS datasets. Our team considered scientific accuracy, data reliability, usability, geographical coverage and technical feasibility. ARES PATH aims to make Mars exploration more accessible for students, researchers and space enthusiasts. It is an educational exploration platform, not a certified astronaut-navigation or safety system.
